Synopsis:
Lakrissa is a tiefling from the grove who is usually quiet flirty and mischievious but has been through hell and back. There is a hint of her joyful nature here but she's much more reserved. She is currently imprisoned in moonrise towers. She usually has one liners, but if lia is dead she delivers the main beats about the tiefling rescue.

Cluster Contexts:
- MOO_Jailbreak_FlirtyTiefling.json: Lakrissa is a tiefling from the grove who normally leans flirty and mischievous but has been hardened by recent trauma; she’s currently imprisoned in Moonrise Towers and is more guarded than usual. In this scene she’s wary of anyone who might be cult‑controlled, bitterly referencing Zevlor and asking if “the cult got inside your head.” Off‑screen a zealous half‑orc Absolute jailer watches the cells, can check for tadpoles and control who comes and goes, and will punish or report escape attempts, so the exchange happens under tight, dangerous scrutiny. The player is likely trying to reassure her and promise rescue; if Lia is already dead Lakrissa abandons quips and delivers the main beats about the tiefling rescue. Finally, other captured tieflings (Cal, Lia, Rolan) and their fate are relevant background and may come up in dialogue.
- HAV_AlfiraTale_ReunionWithFlirty.json: Lakrissa has been resuced from Moonrise by the player and is reunuined with her closest friend, Alfira.
- MOO_Jailbreak_ProdigySister.json: This is lia's main dialogue in moonrise towers. She's been taken captive (along with her brother cal) - she doesn't know if her other brother rolan is alive or dead. Lia is brave and used to being in tough situations, but she's terrified for herself anf her brother (and trying to mask it with anger). Her main dialogue occurs with her in a cell and speaking to the player on the other side of the bars. There are additional branches for when she's in one cell and the player was arrested an in the cell next to her.
- MOO_Jailbreak_Lover.json: Danis is a tiefling from the grove who is being held prisoner in Moonrise towers. In his initial dialogue he terrified and frantic and worried about his partner Bex (who the player may have met in last light inn). He is also a back up to get the escape quest if Lia and Lakrissa (two other tieflings) are dead.
- HAV_BackupLeader.json: Cerys, a tiefling scout, is now present in Last Light along with the others who evaded capture by the cultists. She has reluctantly assumed the role of leader in Zevlor's absence (assuming she hadn't already). She's exhausted by the responisibility but still capable of a little gallows humour.

Off‑screen a zealous half‑orc jailer watches the cells, can check for tadpoles, and will punish or report escape attempts, so the exchange happens under tight, dangerous scrutiny. She’s suspicious anyone might be cult‑controlled—bitterly referencing Zevlor—and is testing whether the player is a friend or under the cult’s influence; the player is typically trying to reassure her and promise rescue.
